title: LibScript Multicloud Marketplace Offer Specification
description: Declarative specification for single-image and multi-unikernel constellation Cloud Marketplace offers across AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Azure Marketplace, and Google Cloud Marketplace.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI validating this marketplace offer document.

offer_id.description: Globally unique alphanumeric offer slug (e.g. openedx-unikernel-appliance).

publisher.description: Registered seller or publisher organization identifier across cloud marketplaces.

product_title.description: Public commercial listing title displayed in marketplace catalogs.

version.description: Semantic release version of the marketplace appliance offer.

summary.description: Concise catalog summary describing the appliance capabilities and architecture.

eula_uri.description: HTTPS URI or repository path to the End-User License Agreement (EULA) bundle.

sbom_path.description: Relative output path where the deterministic SPDX/JSON SBOM is generated and verified.

pricing.description: Commercial pricing and licensing dimension model for the offer.

model.description: Marketplace billing model applied to the listing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for usage or contract rates.

hourly_rate.description: Optional hourly usage rate when model is usage-hourly.

architectures.description: CPU instruction set architectures supported by the published cloud images.

topology_ref.description: Optional repository path to a topology.schema.json constellation blueprint for multi-VM/multi-unikernel appliances.

appliance_images.description: Bootable single-role OS or UEFI-wrapped unikernel images registered for this offer.

items.description: Specification for an individual role image within the marketplace offer.

role.description: Logical role identifier within the constellation (e.g. lms-wsgi, ingress-mfe).

os_profile.description: Repository path to the single-image synthesis/schemas/os-config.schema.json profile.

cloud_boot.description: Cloud firmware boot mode synthesized for hyperscaler VMM compatibility.

default_instance_types.description: Recommended cloud instance machine types per target cloud.

aws.description: Default AWS Nitro EC2 instance type (e.g. m7i.large).

azure.description: Default Azure Gen2 VM SKU (e.g. Standard_D2s_v5).

gcp.description: Default GCP Shielded VM machine type (e.g. n2-standard-2).

exposed_endpoints.description: Whitelisted public network ports permitted through marketplace security groups and firewall rules.

port.description: TCP or UDP port number permitted on external ingress.

health_path.description: Optional HTTP health probe path validated by marketplace deployment templates.

targets.description: Per-cloud marketplace catalog, storage staging, and offer identifiers.

aws_marketplace.description: AWS Marketplace Catalog API and S3 AMI import settings.

enabled.description: Whether AWS Marketplace publishing is enabled for this offer.

s3_staging_bucket.description: S3 bucket name used for aws ec2 import-snapshot staging.

region.description: Primary AWS region for AMI registration and Marketplace Catalog API calls.

azure_marketplace.description: Microsoft Partner Center and Azure Compute Gallery settings.

enabled.description: Whether Microsoft Azure Marketplace publishing is enabled.

resource_group.description: Azure resource group hosting the Compute Gallery.

storage_account.description: Azure Blob storage account staging page-blob VHDs.

compute_gallery.description: Azure Compute Gallery (Shared Image Gallery) name.

plan_id.description: Partner Center Managed Application or VM offer plan identifier.

gcp_marketplace.description: Google Cloud Producer Portal and GCS image import settings.

enabled.description: Whether Google Cloud Marketplace publishing is enabled.

project_id.description: GCP Producer project ID hosting public GCE unikernel images.

gcs_staging_bucket.description: GCS bucket staging disk.raw.tar.gz image archives.

solution_id.description: GCP Producer Portal VM/Terraform solution identifier.
